output.reason: The cited excerpt is just a list item [ev-98f76f5f3c21], but the section it belongs to explains the change [ev-1f419676f177]. Some Loki metrics started with the prefix `cortex_`, and in this release they change to start with `loki_`. That means `cortex_ruler_clients` is renamed to `loki_ruler_clients`. Environments that keep the default `metrics_namespace` of `loki` are exposed, while setting it to `cortex` keeps the old name; that setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release. An exposed environment that does nothing will no longer see the metric under its old `cortex_` name, so the typed assertion can be written. The proposals left every aspect open mainly because no subject family covers metrics, which is a gap in the schema, not in the evidence.
